title: Interim adoption deferred actions log - Oct 2026
content:
Context: quick one-off tracker capturing items we intentionally deferred during the September rollout freeze. Purpose is to list temporary owners, expected re-check window, and blockers so teams can pick up without digging through threads. Not exhaustive; this is an operational scratchpad (lightweight spreadsheet style).

Table (columns: item | owning-team | current-state | temporary-owner | action | est-effort-hrs | blocker | recheck-date)
1) alias-redirection for embed-api | infra | deferred-v1 -> v2 mapping paused | Marcus Chen | add redirect rule + smoke test | 4h | missing cert on staging | 2026-10-18
2) rollout toggle for quant-profiles | serving-runtime | canary paused at 10% | Priya Nair | enable 20% for non-PII customers | 6h | perf regression on long-seq | 2026-10-20
3) docs: dedicated-contract-examples | legal / sales | draft awaiting template updates | Jordan Alvarez | finalize example clauses + sample pricing | 8h | legal wording for data retention | 2026-10-25
4) k8s node-pools tag cleanup | platform-engineering | housekeeping deferred | Marcus Chen | run dry-run then delete stale tags | 3h | CI job overlaps with maintenance window | 2026-10-14
5) console dashboard delta alerting | observability | disabled to reduce noise | Priya Nair | re-enable with finer thresholds | 2h | alert noise source unclear | 2026-10-16
6) sample prompt-eval set update | product-hosted-api | postponed pending eval infra | Evelyn Park | merge new prompt + run subset | 5h | eval infra quota | 2026-10-21
7) partner SLA exception review | company-ops | exceptions table frozen | Jordan Alvarez | validate exceptions older than 30d | 4h | missing contract IDs | 2026-10-19
8) private deployment checklist (on-prem) | private-deployments | checklist partial | Marcus Chen | add KMS/HSM step and signoff | 3h | security team availability | 2026-10-22

Quick notes and heuristics:
- Temporary owners assigned to reduce context-swapping; they are "do + handoff" owners, not final assignees. If work grows >8h, escalate to the owning team lead.
- Recheck-date = date owner should post status on #launch-coord and update this sheet.
- If blocker is "missing cert/contract/infra quota" use the linked_artifacts or tag the relevant team on Slack and paste thread URL here.

Action checklist (short):
- [ ] Marcus: schedule dry-run tag cleanup (due 10/14)
- [ ] Priya: reproduce perf regression with 2k token test (due 10/18)
- [ ] Jordan: collate outstanding exceptions into sheet and flag for legal (due 10/19)
- [ ] Evelyn: run subset eval and post delta summary (due 10/21)

Open questions / unresolved: 
- Are quant-profile canaries allowed to run at 20% for non-PII without infra signoff? (owner: serving-runtime lead)
- Legal needs a short template for a "dedicated sample" contract — can we reuse last quarter's sales template? (owner: legal)

Thread references and quick links: 
- Slack thread (launch freeze): https://slack.redwood/archives/C12345/p166xxxxx
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2126
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/company/launch-readiness-2026

Versioning note: this is intended as a living scratch sheet. When moving items to a formal tracker (JIRA), add the ticket ID in the blocker field and remove the row from this sheet.

Summary: keep this lightweight — daily 5m standup owner updates until recheck-date. If multiple owners hit >2 blockers, request a short sync with company-ops to re-prioritize.
